config.title: Fishing Assistant
config.option.energy_low.description: Test-only: close the configuration menu and set this local player's energy to 1 so automatic eating can be tested immediately.
config.option.energy_full.description: Test-only: close the configuration menu and restore this local player's energy to maximum.
config.option.warp_beach.description: Test-only: warp this local player near Willy's Fish Shop for quick ocean-fishing tests.
config.option.create_bubble.description: Test-only: create a reachable bubble near the current default cast landing point.
config.option.ice_festival.description: Test-only: prepare the Ice Fishing Festival. Use a disposable test save and do not save afterward.
config.option.stardew_valley_fair.descri: Test-only: prepare the Stardew Valley Fair. Use a disposable test save and do not save afterward.
config.option.auto_cast.description: Cast again when the assistant is ready and fishing can safely continue.
config.option.automation_profile.descrip: Choose a coordinated preset that changes multiple automation options together. Editing one of those options changes the profile to Custom.
config.option.auto_hook.description: React when a fish bites without requiring manual input.
config.option.auto_minigame.description: Control the fishing bar while a normal minigame is active.
config.option.auto_close.description: Confirm the caught-fish popup when it is safe to continue.
config.option.auto_treasure.description: Move items from the treasure chest menu into the player's inventory using the configured inventory rules.
config.option.automation_timing.descript: Choose coordinated delays for automatic fishing. Editing a delay below changes this preset to Custom.
config.option.catch_popup_duration.descr: How long the caught-fish popup remains visible before the assistant closes it.
config.option.treasure_loot_delay.descri: How long the treasure chest remains visible before the assistant starts taking items.
config.option.auto_pause.description: Choose whether the assistant warns or pauses when the configured late-night time is reached.
config.option.pause_time.description: The in-game hour when late-night fishing warnings begin.
config.option.warning_count.description: The number of warnings allowed before automatic fishing pauses.
config.option.open_inventory_on_stop.des: Open the inventory after automation stops for late-night or low-energy safety.
config.option.inventory_full_action.desc: Stop leaves the chest open and disables automation. Drop and Discard resolve items that do not fit, then continue fishing.
config.option.treasure_ignore_list: Items to leave in treasure chests
config.option.treasure_ignore_list.descr: Choose which items automatic treasure looting leaves in the chest.
config.option.ignore_junk_in_treasure: Ignore Junk List items in treasure chests
config.option.ignore_junk_in_treasure.de: Leave Junk List items in treasure chests without adding them to the list above.
config.option.ignored_treasure_action.de: Choose what happens when only items listed above remain: keep the chest open, drop them into the world, or discard them.
config.option.junk_disposal.description: Keep junk, discard all eligible Junk List stacks together when the inventory becomes full, or discard each newly acquired quantity immediately.
config.option.junk_lists.description: Choose exactly which newly acquired items may be discarded automatically.
config.option.auto_eat.description: Select food from this player's inventory using the configured timing and energy target.
config.option.auto_eat_trigger.descripti: Eat at the configured energy target, or wait until there is not enough energy for the next cast.
config.option.eat_energy.description: Eat until this energy percentage is reached. When Unable to Cast also ensures enough energy for one cast.
config.option.food_delay.description: Wait before the first item and between additional items so automatic eating can be cancelled.
config.option.preferred_food.description: Choose and order food. The first available item is eaten; listed fish are always allowed.
config.option.food_fallback.description: Choose whether to wait, eat the best energy value, or eat the food that restores the most energy.
config.option.eat_fish.description: Allow fallback selection to eat fish. Fish listed as preferred food are always allowed.
config.option.attach_bait.description: Attach preferred bait from this player's inventory when the rod can use it.
config.option.spawn_bait: Spawn bait when none is available
config.option.spawn_bait.description: Create the preferred bait when automatic attachment cannot find any. This is a cheat option.
config.option.bait_amount.description: The stack size created when spawning bait is enabled and none is available.
config.option.preferred_bait.description: Choose and order preferred bait. The first available item is used; an empty list uses any compatible bait.
config.option.attach_tackle.description: Attach preferred tackle from this player's inventory when the rod has an empty slot.
config.option.preferred_tackle.descripti: Choose and order tackle for the first slot. The first available item is used; an empty list uses any compatible tackle.
config.option.second_tackle.description: Choose and order tackle for the Advanced Iridium Rod's second slot. The first available item is used.
config.option.spawn_tackle: Spawn tackle when none is available
config.option.spawn_tackle.description: Create preferred tackle when automatic attachment cannot find any. This is a cheat option.
config.option.infinite_bait.description: Prevent the assistant's fishing workflow from consuming equipped bait.
config.option.infinite_tackle.descriptio: Prevent the assistant's fishing workflow from consuming tackle durability.
config.option.bite_waiting_time.descript: Scale the bite delay calculated by the game. Fishing level, bait, and tackle still apply.
config.option.bubble_steering: Automatically steer casts toward fishing bubbles
config.option.bubble_steering.descriptio: Steer manual and automatic casts sideways toward a reachable fishing bubble without changing cast power or moving the player.
config.option.automatic_cast_power_adjus: Choose whether suitable cast power is selected for automatic casts, manual casts, both, or neither.
config.option.steering_effort.descriptio: Choose how strongly the assistant can steer left or right. Higher effort does not add cast distance or steer behind the player.
config.option.bubble_marker.description: Draw a vanilla-style frame on the fishing bubble: green when the current cast can reach it, or yellow when it cannot.
config.unavailable.bubble_steering: Enable automatic bubble steering to configure this option.
config.option.skip_minigame.description: Choose whether eligible fishing minigames are completed instantly.
config.option.skip_catches_required.desc: Set how many catches of each fish are required before its minigame can be skipped.
config.option.fish_amount_behavior.descr: Keep the vanilla amount, require at least the selected amount, or use the selected amount exactly.
config.option.fish_amount.description: Set the minimum or fixed amount for ordinary catches. Challenge Bait and legendary catches stay protected.
config.option.fish_quality_behavior.desc: Keep vanilla quality, require at least the selected quality, or use the selected quality exactly.
config.option.fish_quality.description: Choose the minimum or fixed caught-fish quality.
config.option.always_perfect.description: Treat completed fishing minigames as perfect catches when supported.
config.option.max_fish_size.description: Use the maximum size roll for caught fish when supported.
config.option.minigame_assistance.descri: Choose how much help the vanilla fishing minigame provides while you remain in control. Auto Play is configured separately.
config.option.fish_speed.description: Scale the fish's final vanilla movement while preserving its movement pattern. Lower values are easier; 100% is vanilla.
config.option.progress_gain.description: Scale catch progress gained while the fish is inside the bar. Higher values fill the meter faster; 100% is vanilla.
config.option.progress_loss.description: Scale catch progress lost while the fish is outside the bar. Lower values are more forgiving; 0% prevents loss.
config.option.treasure_speed.description: Scale treasure meter progress without changing treasure chance or contents. Higher values fill it faster.
config.option.bar_size.description: Scale the bar size after vanilla applies fishing level, bait, tackle, buffs, and other compatible effects.
config.option.instant_treasure.descripti: Catch a fully revealed treasure chest immediately during the fishing minigame outside festivals. Its items are looted afterward.
config.option.treasure_targeting.descrip: Make automatic minigame play pursue an available treasure chest when fish-catch progress is safe.
config.option.treasure_chance.descriptio: Set the base chance outside festivals. Vanilla luck, bait, tackle, and profession bonuses still apply.
config.option.golden_treasure_chance.des: Set the base chance for existing treasure to be golden outside festivals. Vanilla luck still applies.
config.option.cast_power.description: The initial session cast power. A manual cast held past the unlock time can replace it until the session resets.
config.option.cast_delay.description: How long the player must remain safely ready before the assistant casts again.
config.option.unlock_cast_time.descripti: Hold manual casts at the current session power for this long, then restore vanilla control and remember the power chosen on release. Zero unlocks immediately; three seconds never unlocks.
config.option.starter_rod: Fishing rod when none is owned
config.option.starter_rod.description: Choose the fishing rod added when this local player loads a save without owning one. This never replaces an existing rod.
config.option.hud_visibility.description: Show assistant status only while holding a fishing rod or fishing, keep it visible whenever the HUD is available, or hide it completely.
config.option.hud_position.description: Choose which side of this player's viewport displays assistant status.
config.option.fish_preview.description: Show information about the current fishing target while the minigame is active.
config.option.fish_preview_style.descrip: Use the original Fishing Assistant panel or a vanilla-inspired Sonar Bobber bubble. Classic is used automatically if Sonar compatibility is unavailable.
config.option.fish_name.description: Include the current fish's name in the preview.
config.info.fish_name_classic_only: Fish names are only shown in the Classic preview style.
hud.config_wait_for_cast: The config menu will open after the cast finishes.
integration.gmcm.load_save: Load a save to open Fishing Assistant's custom configuration menu. In-game, selecting Fishing Assistant from this list opens that menu automatically.
hud.junk_relief.discarded: Discarded {0} x{1} to make room for {2}.
config.option.show_treasure.description: Include fishing treasure information in the preview.
config.option.uncaught_fish.description: Allow preview details for fish this player has never caught. Legendary fish must also be enabled separately.
config.option.legendary_fish.description: Allow preview details for uncaught legendary fish when Reveal uncaught fish is on.
config.option.enchant_auto_hook.descript: Temporarily add Auto-Hook to the equipped fishing rod when supported.
config.option.enchant_efficient.descript: Temporarily add Efficient to the equipped fishing rod when supported.
config.option.enchant_master.description: Temporarily add Master to the equipped fishing rod when supported.
config.option.enchant_preserving.descrip: Temporarily add Preserving to the equipped fishing rod when supported.
config.option.remove_enchantments.descri: Remove assistant-added enchantments when the rod is unequipped. They are always removed while saving and never enabled with remote players.
config.option.toggle_automation.descript: Main and optional keybinds used to enable or disable fishing automation for this local player.
Main and optional keybinds used to enable or disable catching treasure chests during automatic minigame play for this local player.
config.option.open_config.description: Main and optional keybinds used to open this custom configuration menu for this local player.
config.slider.description: Drag to adjust. Click the value knob to enter a number.
config.junk_picker.title: Junk list editor
config.item_status.junk_food.tooltip: Also in the Junk List. It may be discarded before Auto Eat can use it.
config.item_status.ignored_via_junk.tool: Ignored because Ignore Junk List items is enabled; it is not copied into this list.
config.treasure_ignore_picker.title: Items to leave in treasure chests
config.confirm.reset: Reset every setting to its default value? Changes are not saved until you select Apply.
config.warning.inventory_discard: Permanently destroys treasure that cannot fit in the inventory.
config.warning.ignored_treasure_discard: Permanently destroys ignored items left in the fishing chest.
config.warning.junk_disposal: Permanently removes eligible items selected in the Junk List while automation is enabled.
config.warning.auto_eat: Consumes eligible food from this player's inventory automatically.
config.warning.eat_fish: Fallback food selection may consume fish automatically.
config.warning.starter_rod_free: Convenience option: adds the selected rod for free when none is owned.
config.warning.spawn_bait_requires_attac: No effect while automatic bait attachment is off.
config.warning.spawn_bait_cheat: Cheat option: creates bait without cost when none is available.
config.warning.spawn_tackle_requires_att: No effect while automatic tackle attachment is off.
config.warning.spawn_tackle_cheat: Cheat option: creates tackle without cost when none is available.
config.warning.auto_minigame_overridden: Skipped catches take priority over automatic minigame play.
config.info.minigame_assistance_skipped: No effect on catches whose minigame is skipped.
config.info.perfect_catches_tracking: Perfect catches made before installing this mod are not counted.
config.info.automation_profile: Selecting a preset changes several automation options at once.
config.info.cast_power_bubble_only: Adjusts cast power only to help reach the selected fishing bubble.
config.info.bubble_marker_colors: Green: reachable with current settings. Yellow: out of range.
config.info.junk_disposal_full: Clears eligible Junk List stacks together only when an incoming item will not fit.
config.unavailable.auto_treasure: Turn on automatic treasure chest looting to configure this option.
config.unavailable.auto_close: Turn on automatic catch popup closing to configure this option.
config.unavailable.treasure_ignore_items: Add items above, or include Junk List items, to configure this option.
config.unavailable.auto_eat: Turn on automatic eating to configure this option.
config.unavailable.food_fallback: Choose a fallback food option to configure this setting.
config.unavailable.fish_amount_behavior: Choose Minimum or Fixed fish amount first.
config.unavailable.fish_quality_behavior: Choose Minimum or Fixed fish quality first.
config.unavailable.attach_bait: Turn on automatic bait attachment to configure this option.
config.unavailable.spawn_bait: Turn on bait spawning to configure this option.
config.unavailable.attach_tackle: Turn on automatic tackle attachment to configure this option.
config.unavailable.auto_minigame_skipped: Turn off minigame skipping to use automatic minigame play.
config.unavailable.minigame_skipped: Turn off minigame skipping to configure minigame assistance.
config.unavailable.skip_catches_required: Choose a catch-based skip mode to set the required count.
config.unavailable.fish_preview: Turn on Fish Preview to configure this option.
config.unavailable.uncaught_fish: Turn on Reveal uncaught fish to configure this option.
config.unavailable.remote_enchantments: Unavailable while remote players are connected.
config.unavailable.fish_preview_style: Enable the fish preview to choose its style.
config.status.defaults_loaded: Defaults loaded. Select Apply to save them.
config.status.save_failed: The configuration could not be saved. Check the SMAPI log.
hud.title: Fishing Assistant
hud.treasure_full.stop: Treasure collection stopped because the inventory is full.
hud.treasure_full.drop: Treasure that could not fit was dropped. Fishing continues.
hud.treasure_full.discard: Treasure that could not fit was discarded. Fishing continues.
hud.bait.spawned: Spawned and attached {1} {0}. This is a cheat option.
hud.tackle.spawned: Spawned and attached {0} to tackle slot {1}. This is a cheat option.
hud.food.ate: Ate {0} automatically and recovered up to {1} energy.
hud.junk_disposal.batch: Trashed {0} junk item(s) from {1} stack(s) after the inventory became full.
hud.late_night.warning: Late-night fishing time {0} reached. Warning {1} of {2}.
hud.late_night.paused: Fishing automation paused safely for the night.
hud.energy.no_food: Fishing automation paused: energy reached the eating threshold, but no suitable food was consumed.
hud.energy.exhaustion: Fishing automation paused to prevent the next cast from exhausting this player.
hud.enchantment.remote_unsupported: Temporary rod enchantments are disabled while remote players are connected.
debug.energy.unavailable: Player energy can only be changed after loading a save.
debug.warp_beach.unavailable: The beach warp is unavailable during an event or minigame.
debug.bubble.unavailable: A test fishing bubble can't be created during an event or minigame.
debug.bubble.no_target: No fishable tile was found near the current cast landing point.
debug.bubble.created: Created a test fishing bubble at tile {0}, {1}.
debug.festival.unavailable: A festival test setup can only be prepared by the host while no event or minigame is active.
debug.festival.prepared: Prepared the festival test setup. Use a disposable save; the game date and time changed.
